# The DOWN action had no_impact, meaning the player is blocked going down from (32, 14)
# Let me re-examine the maze structure by looking at black corridor connectivity

nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
adj = current_frame.segmentation['adjacency_list']

# Find all black nodes and their positions
black_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'B']
print(f"Black nodes: {len(black_nodes)}")

# Find player position
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 24:
        br = n['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in br)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in br)
        print(f"Player at: ({min_row}, {min_col})")
        player_id = n['id']
        break

print(f"Player adjacent to node ids: {player_adj}")
for aid in player_adj:
    an = nodes[aid]
    print(f"  Node {aid}: color={an['color']}, pixels={an['pixels']}, boundary={an['boundary']}")

# Try RIGHT to see if it works
result = action(['RIGHT'])
print(f"\nAfter RIGHT: done={result.get('done')}, no_impact={result.get('no_impact')}")

# Check new position
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] == 24:
        br = n['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in br)
        min_col = min(p[1] for p in br)
        print(f"Player now at: ({min_row}, {min_col})")
